name: What kind of maintenance is required for a new walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required for a new walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining a walk-in shower involves regular cleaning to prevent soap scum and mildew buildup. Using a squeegee after each use on glass doors and tiled surfaces can significantly reduce cleaning effort. Periodically, use appropriate cleaners for tiles, grout, and glass. Inspect grout lines for any signs of wear and reseal them every few years if necessary to maintain waterproofing. Proper ventilation also helps prevent mold.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance includes daily squeegeeing of glass, regular cleaning with appropriate products, and periodic grout inspection and sealing.
